rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening without conscious awareness, especially a reaction or influence.

example.english: When the dog lunged at me, my subconscious reaction was to pull my hand away.
example.traditional: 隻狗撲埋嚟，我下意識咁縮開隻手。
